text: Since I started treatment here, there have been two doctors who are genuinely polite and kind. The nurses, however, are still a bit... 😌 They mumble and grumble, "Don't think we don't hear you, patients. This isn't a free service; your salaries come from your clients' money." There are other nurses who are nice, but the ones I've encountered so far might be...😩 I saw a review on Facebook a long time ago, but never thought I'd experience it myself. If you have a good experience, that's great, but I didn't.

I sincerely apologize to the clinic for not asking for clear information. There was a misunderstanding regarding the appointment time. I'm sorry for causing any inconvenience, but I assure you I had no intention of causing any harm. I deeply regret my actions. My sincerest apologies.
